              Controls

              • W A S D / arrowsWalk (or click the ground)
              • EnterChat
              • I or 3Backpack: everything you own
              • 1, 2Shovel, fishing rod
              • HRide (potion in the crypt)
              • EUse / open
              • Click waterCast your line there
              • TThrow something (then click where)
              • FReel in (flip furniture)
              • Space, A, DFish on: reel in, pull the rod left or right
              • RDecorating: turn a piece
              • SpaceCrypt: attack your target
              • 1, 2, 3Crypt: your skills
              • MCrypt: mana potion
              • BCrypt: Backpack, weapons
              • EscClose a card

              Globe = map. Clock = quests, daily prizes, the Wando Times, the Prize Wheel and the camera.

              Smiley = dances, moves and emotes. Type :) <3 :D ;) :( gg in chat too!

              The crypt with friends: anyone in the same room fights the same monsters. Join a friend from the Dungeon Gate, your player list, or type /join Name. Knocked down? A friend who stands by you picks you up. Hold a skill button to see what it does.

              At the camp: the Sparring Ring (hit each other for fun), Grizzle's forge (three weapons into one better one) and the Infirmary.

                                  Cupcake Chaos

                                  Coins: 100

                                  Level 1

                                  Quick reminder of the job
                                  1. Drag guests to a table.
                                  2. When they wave (!), take the order, then click ORDERS.
                                  3. Click a cake on the counter, then the table with its number.
                                  4. Take the money ($), clear the table, then click DISHES.

                                  Same job in a row = combo! Matching chair colours = bonus. Run out of hearts and they leave!
